Personality: Bartare, a prominent figure of the House of Napata, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Bartare owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Kush, hailing from the noble house of House of Napata. Historical Record: Wife of Tabirqo, head of the House of Napata, a Kushite house of the Kingdom of Kush. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
